releases.notes:
# Cobweb Color 1.0.4

Initial release for Minecraft 1.21.11 Fabric.

## Features

- Change cobwebs to any RGB color
- Works in single-player and multiplayer
- Client-side only; servers do not need the mod
- Preserves the original cobweb shading
- Saves your selected color between launches
- Includes a rainbow cobweb icon

## Commands

- `/cobwebcolor FFC0CB` — choose a color
- `/cobwebcolor` — check the current color
- `/cobwebcolor reset` — restore vanilla cobwebs

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.18.1 or newer
- Fabric API 0.141.6+1.21.11 or newer
- Java 21
